correctness.rationale: At fixed S the independent-contact exploration is distributionally identical to independent bond-percolation reachability from S: every frontier edge is tested once and unbiased independent retention makes all terminal moments equal. The independent enumerator checked all 2^|E| bond patterns and all seed sets/pairs on the only connected types of n<=3, obtaining each stated P3 and triangle Gamma polynomial. An independent directed-arc exhaustive calculation at p=1/5 and 3/5 verified the reachability laws on edge, P3 and K3. The cubic h(p)=1-5p+2p^3 is strictly decreasing through 1/3 and negative on [1/3,1), proving its unique critical root p*=0.203364213796905... and the exact graph-order classification. On K_{1,m}, conditioning on the center activating yields F_m(k)=q_k(1-q_k)(1+(m-k)p)^2+q_k(m-k)p(1-p), q_k=1-(1-p)^k. Substituting u=(1-p)^(m-2), the independently symbolically verified second difference is p^2*u*((5+4p)-(14-4p-p^2)*u), universally for integer m>=2. Because 0<R=(5+4p)/(14-4p-p^2)<1, this is positive exactly when u<R, giving the sharp specified pair threshold m*=3+floor(logR/log(1-p)) and small-p scale log(14/5)/p. Exact star bond checks m=2..7 for all k and five rational sample p corroborate; infinite m and all real p follow algebraically, not from finite tests. Endpoint p=0,1 deterministic, correctly excluded. No assertion of global minimal star order is made.

value.rationale: Submodularity supports the central greedy guarantee for expected influence; variance of the terminal infected population is a natural second-moment risk metric whose submodularity cannot be inferred from expectation. The claim locates the minimum nontrivial connected graph order and a sharp p boundary across all types on up to three vertices, then proves no uniformly positive low-transmissibility regime can rescue variance submodularity on all connected graphs. The specified last-two-leaf witness has an exact finite threshold and rare-transmission scaling, explaining the structural obstruction rather than just exhibiting a small arbitrary sign computation. This motivated natural classification and global graph-family boundary has independent mathematical utility without claiming an approximation guarantee.
